limitations: This is a candidate-worktree M0 measurement, not a base-versus-candidate comparison.
The earlier 15-case seed timing is not a performance baseline for this 50-case workload; the two medians are intentionally not compared.
The command includes Cargo and ten test-binary launches; the scorecard test itself reported 0.19 seconds after release compilation.
The scorecard remains non-claim-eligible because recursive returns, edit sequences, CLI/LSP parity, real-project reductions, Unknown counters, and the full performance matrix are incomplete.
Cold workspace indexing, warm workspace indexing, didChange latency, hover/completion query latency, allocations, full-project CPU, and goshposh peak RSS remain unmeasured for this goal.
